description: TLUSTY NLTE model atmosphere grids with SYNSPEC optical spectra, distributed at tlusty.oca.eu as per-composition tar archives of per-atmosphere files. The exact tar inventory (archive names, sizes) still requires live verification; the per-file format facts below are verified against downloads (2026-10-09, downstream projects).

ostar2002.compositions: 10 scaled-solar values of Z/Z_sun from 0 to 2
ostar2002.note: the published set narrows at the hottest models

bstar2006.note: the published set narrows at the hottest models

format_facts: one gzip ASCII file per atmosphere and spectrum kind: {comp}{teff:05d}g{logg*100:03d}v{vmicro*10:02d}.vis.{7|17}.gz
kind 7 = detailed spectrum, kind 17 = continuum; vispec tars carry both
two columns: wavelength [Angstrom, AIR in the optical] and Eddington flux H_lambda [erg/s/cm^2/Angstrom]
SYNSPEC native sampling ~0.03 Angstrom per point in the red optical (R ~ 2e5)
on-disk sets may drop the .gz suffix; a reader given such a path opens path + '.gz'

on_disk_sets_seen.ostar2002: 69 kind-7 files, composition G (Z/Z_sun = 1), vmicro 1 km/s
on_disk_sets_seen.bstar2006: 163 kind-7 files, composition BG (Z/Z_sun = 1), vmicro 2 km/s
